title: First run A: create the administrator account + the licence screen
description: Segment A of the first-run video. Filmed on a demo profile with NO licence rows so the licence screen appears after the account is created; it is explained and hovered only (a real Start-trial click would contact the licensing server). record.py --licence-intro films this, restores the licence, and joins segment B in front of the Terms window.

steps.narration: The first time ScanFinder opens, it asks you to create the administrator account — the one that manages users, settings and filing. There are no default logins; everything stays on this computer.
steps.caption: First run: create the administrator account

steps.narration: First, a username — what you'll type to sign in.
steps.caption: 1. Username — what you type to sign in

steps.narration: Then a display name, shown inside the app.
steps.caption: 2. Display name — shown in the app

steps.narration: Now a password of at least eight characters. Choose a passphrase you'll remember — ScanFinder is offline, so there's no forgot-password email.
steps.caption: 3. Password — 8+ characters, no email reset exists

steps.narration: This recovery code is shown once. It's the only way to reset the administrator password if it's forgotten — print or copy it now and keep it safe, away from the PC.
steps.caption: SAVE THIS CODE — shown once, the only way to reset

steps.narration: Tick to confirm you've saved it,
steps.caption: 6. Confirm you've saved it

steps.narration: Next, ScanFinder asks for a licence. You see this screen once per computer, and it needs the internet only for this step.
steps.caption: Licence — once per computer, online just for this

steps.narration: For the free 14-day trial, enter your company name, your name and an email address,
steps.caption: 8. Free trial: company, name, email

steps.narration: then click Start trial. The trial is tied to this computer.
steps.caption: 9. Start trial — tied to this PC

steps.narration: Already bought Scan Finder? Paste the activation key from your purchase email here, optionally name this device, and click Activate.
steps.caption: Bought it? Paste the activation key → Activate

steps.narration: Once the trial starts or the key is accepted, ScanFinder continues to the Terms of Use.
steps.caption: Next: the Terms of Use
